---
title: "Session 15 guided lab"
subtitle: "Bootstrap, permutation, and resampling design"
---

Work in **BIOS6301-mywork.Rproj**. Copy the starter from the separate course clone
into `work/session15/`: [Quarto](starter/resampling-lab.qmd) or [R Markdown](starter/resampling-lab.Rmd).
All inputs are synthetic.

## Start with the project question

We have one dataset. Choose the repeated operation from the question:

| Question | Method | Output |
|---|---|---|
| How uncertain is an estimate? | Bootstrap participants | SE and interval |
| Is the observed difference surprising under a specified null? | Permute allowed assignments | p-value |

The melanoma and promotion-decision projects illustrate these two questions.
This lab uses a synthetic cohort of 60 participants. Cross-validation is taught
with regression models in Session 16.


## Tasks following the lecture

1. **Bootstrap within arms** — Estimate the Treatment-minus-Placebo mean difference in 12-week SBP. Bootstrap participants within each arm. Report bootstrap SE and a percentile interval, and compare the SE with Welch. Basic intervals, bias, and three-seed stability comparisons are optional follow-up.
2. **Permutation tests** — Under the sharp null for the supplied completely randomized design, permute arm labels, retain 999 statistics, and compute the adjusted two-sided p-value. Report its resolution. The binomial Monte Carlo interval and supplied enumeration of all 70 assignments for four participants per arm are optional follow-up.
3. **Choose resampling units** — Use trial_long to compare row and participant bootstraps. Preserve all visits and repeated copies of sampled participants. Explain how paired, site-stratified, or clinic-randomized designs change the resampling or reassignment rule.


## Paired-data follow-up

For treatment-arm participants, calculate follow-up minus baseline SBP. Bootstrap
these paired changes and report the mean, SE, and percentile interval. Explain why
this does not estimate a causal treatment effect, why independent resampling of the
two visits is inappropriate, and why time labels cannot automatically be permuted.

## In-class route and follow-up

Build one bootstrap and one permutation calculation, then inspect participant and paired resampling. Detailed interval comparisons and exact enumeration are follow-up work.

## Exit evidence

Submit the source and rendered report with results, checks, interpretation, and
an AI-use disclosure. Identify the analysis sample or resampling unit for each result.
